messages:
tara: Customer support flagged a double provisional line after a reconnect + toolcall; looks like streaming retry doubled a partial charge. anyone seen this exact combo?

jamal: Yes — pattern is: provisional at stream start, then toolcall binds tokens to that session. If client reconnects and router falls back, we can create a second provisional and finalizer may count both.

ed: Do we have a quick mitigation? Can we auto-credit the duplicate?

maria: UX: customers see two separate rows; we should show "provisional (may be merged)" and a hover explaining dedupe logic.

jamal: Short fix: finalizer should dedupe by toolcall_id before finalizing. If the same toolcall_id already has a finalized charge within X seconds, skip finalizing the newer provisional.

ben: Concern: where do routers get toolcall_id on fallback? if headers are dropped we lose linkage. need router audit.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-078 created, billing-team tagged.

tara: Action items: jamal -> implement finalizer guard behind flag; maria -> console tooltip + prov-merge metric; ed -> run small canary to measure KV TTL impact; ben -> router header audit.

jamal: will open PR with feature flag `prov_dedupe_by_toolcall` and add metric `prov_dedupe_skipped`. aiming for canary tomorrow.

maria: I'll prototype tooltip copy: "Provisional charges may be merged if they correspond to the same tool invocation. We show the merged preview here." will add analytics event.

tara: Thanks. keep thread updated if other dup scenarios show up (prefix truncation, model swap, cross-region).
